mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "models" searches/lists AI models with filters. "model-detail" fetches full detail (all versions, files, download URLs) for specific model ID(s). "images" searches the image gallery. "creators" lists/searches usernames. "tags" lists/searches tags.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Free-text search term. Used by "models" mode (searches model names), "creators" mode (searches usernames), and "tags" mode (searches tag names).

tag.title: Tag filter
tag.description: "models" mode only -- only return models with this exact tag.

username.title: Username filter
username.description: "models" or "images" mode -- only return items created by this exact username.

types.title: Model types
types.description: "models" mode only -- only return models of these type(s). Leave empty for all types.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Order to return results in. "models" mode: Highest Rated / Most Downloaded / Most Liked / Most Discussed / Most Collected / Most Images / Newest / Oldest. "images" mode: Most Reactions / Most Comments / Most Collected / Newest / Oldest / Random.

period.title: Time window
period.description: "models" or "images" mode -- only consider items from this time window.

nsfw.title: NSFW filter (images mode)
nsfw.description: "images" mode only -- filter by content rating. Leave empty for the platform default (safe-for-work only, unauthenticated).

modelId.title: Model ID
modelId.description: "model-detail" mode: a single model ID. "images" mode: only return images generated with this model.

modelIds.title: Model IDs
modelIds.description: "model-detail" mode only -- multiple model IDs to fetch full detail for in one run.

modelVersionId.title: Model version ID
modelVersionId.description: "images" mode only -- only return images generated with this specific model version.

postId.title: Post ID
postId.description: "images" mode only -- only return images from this specific post.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of results to return (for "models"/"images"/"creators"/"tags" modes). Pagination is followed automatically until this cap or the end of the result set, whichever comes first.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: "model-detail" mode only -- how many model IDs to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default. Not required for this endpoint (no WAF was found -- it is Civitai's own official public API), but kept on for production robustness.
